newsitem.title: USA: San Francisco stadium calls on port funds - paper.
newsitem.headline: San Francisco stadium calls on port funds - paper.

text.p: Parking ticket revenues collected on Port of San Francisco properties could help pave the way for a new stadium for the San Francisco Giants baseball team, the San Francisco Chronicle reported Wednesday.
The newspaper reported that Mayor Willie Brown wants to use $1.2 million a year to help relocate a maintenance yard now sitting on the ballpark site.
Moving the yard has been the subject of heated negotiations between the city and the Giants in recent months, the newspaper said.
In September, the Giants said funding of the project would include:
* $140 million from a syndicated bank financing arranged by Chase Securities Inc.
* $100 million in naming rights, sponsorship rights, concession rights and charter seat sales.
* $10 million to $15 million in tax increment financing provided by the San Francisco Redevelopment Agency.
